notes.title: GRAPPIN Update・v1.0.7
notes.notes:
Hi there,

GRAPPIN has been updated! (v1.0.7)

Changelist:
・Keyboard: the keys I, J, K, and L are now supported for controlling the character. Right Shift key can also be used for sprint. (for left-handed players)
Note: while a key remap feature is being considered, this fix should offer a more comfortable way for left-handed players to enjoy the game in the meantime.
・The difficulty in "Ancient City" area has been slightly adjusted.
・New confirmation popups have been implemented.
・In-game Control Guides have been adjusted to reflect the left-handed controls. 
・Some adjustments in "The Peak" area have been made to improve the visibility. 
・Performances in "Ancient City", "Forgotten Ridge" and "The Peak" areas have been improved.
・Minor bug fixing.

Please feel free to join GRAPPIN Discord server!
https://discord.gg/8y5a3bcadf

Thank you for playing! 
Ahmin

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41019476/f3940b1ec7d52a3b91564da502459132df51b411.jpg

notes.title: GRAPPIN Update・v1.0.6
notes.notes:
Hi there,

GRAPPIN has been updated! (v1.0.6)

Changelist:
・Fixed an issue where the screen could turn pitch black in the Mysterious Shrine.
・Various game balance adjustments.
・Various adjustments in the game menus.
・Gamepad: the menu can be displayed by pressing the Menu button. (Xbox controller)
・Gamepad: the left gamepad stick is now supported in the game menus. 
・Gamepad: the Relic screen can now be closed with the B button on a gamepad.
・Gamepad: the Relic screen can now be displayed with the View button. (Xbox controller)
・Fixed an issue where the menu couldn't be opened in one of the levels.
・Minor bug fixing. 

If you have any issues with the game, please feel free to join GRAPPIN Discord server!

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: GRAPPIN Update・v1.0.5 - Introducing the Aim Assist!
notes.notes:
Hi there,

GRAPPIN has been updated! (v1.0.5)

The Aim Assist option has been added. 
With the Aim Assist option toggled, the reticle with snap to the Clay Block as soon as it touches it. 
The Aim Assist option can be handy when playing with a controller or on Steam Deck. 

The Aim Assist option can be toggled from the Game Settings. 

Changelist:
・Various bug fixes
・Various adjustments
・Added Aim Assist option

If you have any issues with the game, please feel free to join GRAPPIN Discord server!
https://discord.gg/8y5a3bcadf

Thank you for playing! 
Ahmin

notes.title: GRAPPIN News #2 - Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I have been working on GRAPPIN alone in my spare time, with Benoit who is in charge of the soundtrack and sound design.

We were aiming to release the game this year but after a playtest session (which went well!), we figured that a lot of fixes are needed if we were to put GRAPPIN to the quality level we are seeking for.

GRAPPIN will be released somewhere in early 2022.  

We're not far from the final game but we need to put more work in the polish and bug fixing. Game development is tough, making a game on your own is even tougher and making on your own AND in your spare time is definitely something else...

Nevertheless, I hope that you're looking forward to GRAPPIN!
